characters.name: Bulwark
characters.notes: Guard 13 with the riot shield. Toughness 1 from Force +3.

characters.name: Rook
characters.notes: Toughness 1 from Force +4; Kevlar does not stack with it.

characters.name: Patchwork
characters.notes: Kit sits outside the slots. Pick 3 items each Night; take Smoke or Armor when guns are expected.

opening.title: The Calloway Annex is on fire
opening.text: 11:40 pm, Fifth Street. The annex behind the Calloway Apartments is burning, and the fire trucks are late. A family is screaming from a third-floor window. Out back, three Saints are loading empty gas cans into a van.

confrontation.title: The Tidewater Cannery
confrontation.text: The cannery stinks of old fish and bleach. Marco is in the freezer. The Butcher is waiting on the kill floor.

enemies.name: The Butcher (Vic Saldana)
enemies.trait: Spite. Fraying: he starts breaking things that can't fight back. Breaking: he goes for the hostage.
enemies.trick: Meat hook (2 Drive): drag a hero from an adjacent zone into his.
enemies.weakness: His old gym. Anyone who knew him then can rattle him: Edge on Presence attacks.
enemies.answer_toughness: The hooks and chains hazard on the Kill Floor, and his Presence threats.
enemies.line: Force +4 · Guard 12 Wits 13 Poise 14 · Harm 10 · Toughness 1 · 2 turns a round vs 3 heroes, plus 1 free threat

enemies.name: Fifth Street Saints
enemies.line: Attack +2 · Guard 13 Wits 12 Poise 12 · one pistol in the group · max 2 Harm per attack · they run when half the gang is down

notes: Seed for the demo campaign. The case block goes in gm_secrets.case; nothing in it may reach a player device. Flairs for Bulwark and Patchwork are deliberately empty: pick them at the table.

case.title: The Butcher of Fifth Street

facets.who: FIXED: Delia Marsh, property manager for Harbor & Main Holdings. She hired the Butcher's crew.
facets.what_leaning: Empty the Calloway Apartments before Friday's city inspection. Under 10 occupied units, the city condemns it and Harbor & Main buys it for nothing. (Floating: the theory decides.)
facets.where_leaning: Torch Calloway Friday night; hostage Marco Delgado held at the Tidewater Cannery. (Floating: the theory decides.)

cast.name: The Butcher (Vic Saldana)
cast.motive: Paid well, likes the work, wants Fifth Street for himself
cast.hides: He's scared of Marsh's boss, whom he's never met

cast.name: Delia Marsh
cast.role: Culprit, property manager, Harbor & Main Holdings
cast.motive: Her bonus rides on the Calloway block; reports to 'A.V.'
cast.hides: Hired the Saints; drove to the cannery at 2am

cast.name: Rosa Delgado
cast.role: Tenant organizer at Calloway, leading a rent strike
cast.hides: Got an anonymous $20,000 buyout offer and hasn't told anyone

cast.name: Officer Dale Petrakis
cast.hides: Takes cash from the Saints to look away

cast.name: Kenny 'Two Coats' Lam
cast.hides: Sold the Saints the gasoline cans; informs for Petrakis

cast.name: Councilman Harold Whitby
cast.hides: Donations from Harbor & Main; scheduled Friday's inspection

leads.name: A Saint on the corner of Fifth and Main

clues: A gas-soaked rag at the burned annex, printed with an old Tidewater Seafood logo
Petrakis's patrol log has him off his route the night of the fire
Kenny Lam's ledger: six gas cans sold for cash to 'Saints guys' two days before the fire
Rosa has an unsigned letter offering $20,000 if her family moves out by Friday
The Saints are carrying new pistols, paid for in crisp bank-banded cash
A burner phone on a Saint: repeated calls to a number that rings at a downtown property office
City inspection of Calloway set for Friday: fewer than 10 occupied units and it's condemned
A fisherman saw a silver Lexus at the waterfront around 2am, twice this week
Marco was last seen arguing with a Saint outside a bar near the docks
Whitby's office pushed the inspection date up by a month

personal.bulwark: Her old fire station got a stand-down call during the annex fire. The order came from the city, not the chief.
personal.rook: The Butcher trained at Rook's old gym years ago. He came by last week asking if Tommy Reyes still lives around here.
personal.nightjar: The Saints' van has the same fake plates as the van that ran her brother off the road.
personal.patchwork: The fire was started with a timer circuit he recognizes. He built that design for a paying client two years ago.
personal.ledger: Harbor & Main's shell structure matches a fraud case she flagged years ago that got buried.

scheme: 1: A second Calloway family gets a brick through the window and a Harbor & Main notice
3: Rosa's apartment is trashed as a warning
5: Calloway tenants vote to take the buyout and leave
6: Calloway burns Friday night, the Butcher's crew moves Marco
case.hostage: Marco Delgado, 19, Rosa's son. Grabbed at Scheme tick 2 if not sooner prevented; held in the Cannery freezer.
case.opening: Night 1 opens on the Calloway annex fire: a family trapped on the third floor (obstacle rescue, rating +1, defense 13) and 3 Saints loading their van out back (a short tutorial fight). Rosa Delgado finds the heroes after.
case.confrontation: The Tidewater Cannery. The Butcher plus 1 group of 3 Saints for 3 heroes (2 groups for 4). Hostage clock 4. Heroes win by dropping the Butcher, or by reaching the Freezer and freeing Marco with an Interact while no enemy is in that zone.
arc_clues: Every damaged building has an eviction notice from Harbor & Main Holdings (calling card)
Delia Marsh's phone: texts to 'A.V.' saying 'Calloway on schedule'
Harbor & Main's registered agent is a law firm that represents Augustine Voss
